brackets_single.source: IRC s1 as made permanent by OBBBA 2025; 2026 inflation adjustments per IRS projections
brackets_single.notes: Refresh from IRS Rev. Proc. for TY2026 when published.

brackets_mfj.source: IRC s1 as made permanent by OBBBA 2025; 2026 inflation adjustments per IRS projections

standard_deduction.source: IRC s63(c) as amended by OBBBA 2025 ($15,750/$31,500 for 2025, indexed)

top_ordinary_rate.source: IRC s1(j) made permanent by OBBBA 2025
top_ordinary_rate.notes: Used by the PFIC excess-distribution calculation (s1291 taxes allocations at highest ordinary rate).

ltcg_thresholds_single.source: IRC s1(h); 2026 inflation adjustments per IRS projections

ltcg_thresholds_mfj.source: IRC s1(h); 2026 inflation adjustments per IRS projections

niit.source: IRC s1411; thresholds statutory and unindexed

regimes.notes: Excess-distribution is the default; QEF requires fund-supplied PFIC annual information statements (rarely available for UK funds); MTM requires marketable stock.

form.source: IRC s1298(f); Form 8621 required per PFIC per year (limited exceptions)

de_minimis_reporting_exception.source: Treas. Reg. 1.1298-1(c)(2): s1298(f) filing exception for aggregate PFIC value under thresholds (no excess distributions, no elections)
de_minimis_reporting_exception.notes: Reporting exception only — the taxing regime still applies on disposition/distribution.

estate_exemption.source: IRC s2010(c) as amended by OBBBA 2025: $15,000,000 basic exclusion for 2026, indexed thereafter

nonresident_alien_exemption_equivalent.source: IRC s2102(b): unified credit of $13,000 ≈ $60,000 exemption equivalent for non-resident non-citizens (US-situs assets)
nonresident_alien_exemption_equivalent.notes: UK/US estate tax treaty (1979) may extend a prorated exemption — modelled as treaty credit assumption in Module 3, stated in report.

annual_gift_exclusion.source: IRC s2503(b); 2026 inflation adjustment per IRS projections

feie.source: IRC s911; 2026 inflation adjustment per IRS projections

fbar_threshold.source: 31 CFR 1010.350: aggregate foreign account value exceeding $10,000 at any time in year

form_8938_thresholds_abroad.source: IRC s6038D; Treas. Reg. 1.6038D-2 (taxpayers living abroad)

us_situs_asset_classes.source: IRC ss2104-2105; US-incorporated stock is US-situs regardless of custody location (including via ADR)

non_us_situs_asset_classes.source: IRC s2105: bank deposits and portfolio-interest debt of NRAs excluded from US situs
